callScript.title: Before you call, try saying this
callScript.intro: If you are not sure how to start the call, use these sentences as a guide. They are only examples and do not replace advice from the organisation.
callScript.line1: Hello. I'm calling because I'd like some advice.
callScript.line1Topic: Hello. I'm calling because I'd like some advice about {topic}.
callScript.line2: This is what happened. (Briefly say when, where and what happened.)
callScript.line3: Is there anything I can do? What should I prepare?
callScript.tip1: If Korean is hard for you, ask: "Can I get advice in another language?"
callScript.tip2: Keep dates, places and things like text messages or contracts next to you so it is easier to explain.
callScript.tip3: You only need to give your name or contact details if the counsellor asks for them.
callScript.note: Follow the organisation's own guidance on how advice works. If you are in danger now, call 112 (police) or 119 (ambulance) straight away.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: How LINKRIGHTS handles information, in plain language.

sections.title: There are no accounts
sections.body: LINKRIGHTS has no sign-up and no login. There is no field anywhere on this site that asks for your name, email or phone number.

sections.title: AI questions and answers are not stored on our server
sections.body: Your question is sent to the AI service (OpenAI) to produce an answer. Neither the question nor the answer is stored on the LINKRIGHTS server — there is no database to store them in. To stop one person from asking too many times in a short period, the server briefly counts requests per internet address (IP) in memory. That count disappears when the server restarts and is not linked to what you asked. When something fails, a minimal technical record (time and type of error) may appear in the server log.

sections.title: What is kept in this browser only
sections.body: These four are never sent to our server and stay in the browser you are using: (1) rights information you saved with the star, (2) items you ticked in a checklist, (3) your display settings (text size, light or dark), and (4) whether you already pressed “Was this helpful?”. An AI conversation is held in the tab you have open and disappears when you close it. None of this is visible on another device or browser.

sections.title: If you want to delete what is saved
sections.body: Saved rights information can be removed on the “Saved” screen, and a checklist with “Clear all ticks”. An AI conversation disappears when you press “New question” or close the tab. To clear everything at once, delete this site’s data in your browser settings. Because none of it is on our server, there is nothing for you to ask us to delete.

sections.title: What the “Was this helpful?” button sends
sections.body: Pressing it sends four things only: helpful or not, the language of the page, which topic or which rights information it was, and whether the AI answer used registered material. The question and the answer are not sent, and we cannot tell who pressed it. It is written as a single line in the server log, not a database, and is used only to count which answers help. If you do not press it, nothing is sent.

sections.title: Emails sent to the Q&A board
sections.body: Questions for the board are not saved on the site; they come to us by email. After reading, we remove anything that could identify you and post only the question and the answer. If you write “private”, we reply by email only. Your email stays in our inbox, so tell us in the same thread if you would like it deleted.

sections.title: Please do not enter these
sections.body: Do not enter your name, contact details, address, passport number, alien registration number, visa number or medical records. Describing the situation is enough. We check for such details before sending and warn you, but we cannot catch every case.

sections.title: No cookies, no advertising
sections.body: This site carries no advertising and uses no tracking cookies or analytics tools. Search words and the area you pick appear in the address bar only and are not stored on our server.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: The official websites we link to are run by those organisations. Their handling of personal data follows their own policies.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: If you have any question about privacy, please write to the contact email below.
